name: Microsoft Defender for Office 365
summary: Defender for Office 365 adds impersonation protection, attachment scanning and quarantine controls on top of the basic filtering that every Microsoft 365 cloud mailbox already has. Plan 1 lists at $2 per user a month and Plan 2 at $5, both paid yearly. Microsoft's documentation describes it for Microsoft 365 cloud mailboxes.

facts.text: Impersonation protection for users and domains is available only in Defender for Office 365. Microsoft's anti-phishing policies for all cloud mailboxes cover spoofing but not impersonation.
Each anti-phishing policy can protect up to 350 users and 50 custom domains from impersonation, and by default no senders or domains are configured.
Malware and high-confidence phishing messages are always quarantined, and quarantine cannot be turned off. Users cannot release their own quarantined malware messages.
Spam and phishing quarantine is kept for 15 days in the default anti-spam policy and 30 days in the Standard and Strict preset policies. Malware quarantine is kept for 30 days and cannot be changed.
Microsoft offers a 90-day trial of Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 through the Microsoft Defender portal.

plans.name: Plan 1
plans.notes: Paid yearly on an annual subscription that auto-renews

plans.name: Plan 2
plans.notes: Paid yearly on an annual subscription that auto-renews. Adds tracking of cyberthreat campaigns that might affect your organization
